entry.title: Commission preliminary finds TikTok in breach of Digital Services Act for failing to ensure safe accounts for minors
entry.summary: European Commission Press release Brussels, 24 Jul 2026 Today, the European Commission sent TikTok preliminary findings indicating that TikTok accounts of minors do not meet the safety standards required under the Digital Services Act (DSA).
